scale.5: No visible/audible defect for this dimension.
scale.4: Minor defect a child viewer would not notice; no fix needed for a draft.
scale.3: Noticeable defect; story still readable; fix before final.
scale.2: Major defect; breaks the shot's intent for this dimension.
scale.1: Broken or absent (e.g. wrong character, silent clip, required line missing).

pass_rule: dimension passes iff score >= 4 and no defect with severity high|blocker
overall_rule: overall passes iff every applicable dimension passes
kids_draft_rule: acceptable iff no blocker defect, no dimension score <= 2, and no content a parent would object to
not_applicable: script_adherence is n/a (score 5, pass, na=true) when the spec has no speech lines

attribution.prompt_spec: Spec/compiled prompt is contradictory, ambiguous, or asks for something wrong (fix upstream in planner/compiler).
attribution.omni_limit: Spec is clear and consistent; the video model failed to render it (retry/seed/model capability).
attribution.reference: Reference sheet/plate/first-frame image caused it (off-model ref, conflicting refs, chained last frame).
attribution.pipeline: Orchestration issue outside the prompt text (duration, chaining, muxing, post-processing).
attribution.unknown: Cannot be determined from available evidence.

character_consistency.question: Do characters match their reference sheets and stay the same within the clip?

tags.CHAR_OFF_MODEL_REF: Character design differs from the reference sheet from the start.
tags.CHAR_DRIFT_IN_CLIP: Character design changes mid-clip (face, eyes, head, colour, proportions).
tags.CHAR_FEATURE_ADDED: Feature not in the design appears (e.g. mouth on a mouthless robot).
tags.CHAR_WARDROBE_DRIFT: Clothing/accessories change or differ from spec.
tags.CHAR_DUPLICATE: Same character appears twice / extra unscripted character.
tags.CHAR_MISSING: Scripted character absent for all or most of the clip.

temporal_consistency.question: Is motion continuous frame to frame without flicker, morphing, or jumps?

tags.TEMP_MORPH: Bodies or objects melt/morph between frames.
tags.TEMP_JUMP: Discontinuous jump in time or pose without a cut.
tags.TEMP_HARD_CUT: Hard cut inside what must be a single continuous take.
tags.TEMP_FREEZE: Frozen/stalled frames or dead air at start/end.
tags.TEMP_DURATION_MISMATCH: Rendered duration deviates > 10% from spec duration_s.

spatial_consistency.question: Are positions, screen direction, scale and layout coherent?

tags.SPAT_SCREEN_SIDE_WRONG: Character on the wrong screen side vs spec, or flips mid-shot.
tags.SPAT_SCALE_DRIFT: Relative size of characters/props changes implausibly.
tags.SPAT_LAYOUT_CHANGE: Room geometry (table, door, window) rearranges within the clip.

scene_consistency.question: Does the setting match the location plate and the scene's continuity state?

tags.SCENE_SETTING_MISMATCH: Location does not match the location plate / spec setting.
tags.SCENE_LIGHTING_SHIFT: Time of day or lighting changes without motivation.
tags.SCENE_OPENING_STATE_WRONG: Opening state contradicts spec continuity (e.g. door open when it must be shut).
tags.SCENE_PREV_SHOT_BREAK: Visible continuity break vs the previous shot's end state.

object_permanence.question: Do props persist, stay single, and keep their state?

tags.OBJ_MORPH: Object design changes (e.g. door gains/loses glass panes).
tags.OBJ_STATE_RESET: Object state reverts (e.g. puddle reappears after being wiped).

tags.PHYS_IMPOSSIBLE_MOTION: Motion without cause, impossible limb/joint motion.

action_adherence.question: Does every scripted sequence step happen, by the right actor, in order, reaching the end state?

tags.ACT_STEP_MISSING: A sequence step does not happen.
tags.ACT_WRONG_ACTOR: Step performed by the wrong character.
tags.ACT_INCOMPLETE: Step started but end_state not reached.
tags.ACT_UNSCRIPTED: Significant unscripted action that changes the story beat.

camera_adherence.question: Do shot size, angle, movement and focus match the spec?

tags.CAM_SIZE_WRONG: Shot size differs from spec (e.g. MCU requested, WS rendered).
tags.CAM_MOVE_WRONG: Movement differs (static requested but camera moves, or missing dolly/pan).
tags.CAM_UNREQUESTED_CUT: Camera cuts to a new angle in a single-take spec.
tags.CAM_FOCUS_WRONG: Focus target not the spec focus subject.

style_consistency.question: Does the look match the spec style (2D gouache/watercolour) throughout?

tags.STYLE_RENDER_MISMATCH: Render style differs from spec (3D/photoreal/flat vector).
tags.STYLE_TEXT_OVERLAY: Text, captions, watermarks or UI on screen.
tags.STYLE_PALETTE_OFF: Palette/grade clearly off the spec look.

audio.question: Is the audio track present, clean, plausible and synced?

tags.AUD_SFX_MISSING: Key spec SFX for on-screen action absent.
tags.AUD_MUSIC_UNWANTED: Music present when spec says music:false.
tags.AUD_VOICE_WRONG: Voice timbre/age/character inconsistent with the speaker.
tags.AUD_LIPSYNC_OFF: Mouth motion not synced with speech.
tags.AUD_WRONG_MOUTH: A non-speaking character's mouth moves to the line.

script_adherence.question: Are the scripted lines spoken verbatim, in the right language, by the right speaker, at the right beat?

tags.SCRIPT_WORDS_WRONG: Words differ materially from the script.
tags.SCRIPT_LANG_WRONG: Spoken in a different language than spec lang.
tags.SCRIPT_TIMING_WRONG: Spoken at the wrong beat (before/after the wrong sequence step).
tags.SCRIPT_DELIVERY_WRONG: Delivery clearly contradicts spec (e.g. shout vs whisper).
